  - `invoices` array has all `fromId` invoices reassigned to `intoId` (using normalized IDs)
- Errors:
  - `CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND` if either ID not found in array
  - `SAME_CUSTOMER` if both IDs are the same customer
- Never mutates input arrays
